decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Photo log of windows Received: 13 July 2012
Block Plan, Design & Access Statement, Heritage Statement, Planning Statement, Site Location Plan, SCO113EL Received: 17 July 2012
Window Replacement Schedule Received: 20 February 2012 
001-BATH-WG0102/A, 001-BATH-WG03/A, 001-BATH-WF03-04/A, 001-BATH-WF02/A, 001-BATH-WF01/A, SCO12EL Received: 11 April 2013 
001-BATH-WF01/B, 001-BATH-WG05/A/PROPOSED Received: 13 June 2013 001-BATH-WG04/B/PROPOSED Received: 14 June 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 6 - The timber framed casements shall be painted and maintained as white.
Condition : 7 - The thickness of the two glass panes and air gap shall not exceed 12mm.
description: To replace existing double glazed timber casements with double glazed timber casement windows
